question: Justify why a junction diode is suitable for converting alternating current into unidirectional current.

options.A: A junction diode is suitable for rectification because it conducts easily in forward bias but blocks in reverse bias. As AC reverses polarity, it allows load current during one half-cycle and nearly blocks the other, producing unidirectional pulsating current.
options.B: A diode is suitable for rectification because it has the same resistance in both bias directions.
options.C: A diode converts AC to DC by conducting only during reverse bias and blocking the forward-biased half-cycle.
options.D: A diode rectifies current because it permanently stores charge and does not require bias.
